svg.text: 390 Adventure (2025+) LED lamp same part fits left and right
Inside bend radius 1.5 K 0.42 mass 68.6 g
Finish: deburr all edges, bead blast, black textured powder coat
REV A: lamp and mount dimensions are scaled from photographs, not measured. Confirm M1-M10 on a real lamp before cutting metal.
x = 0 root face of lamp head
back wall follows the lamp taper, 9.2°
ISOMETRIC (not to scale, lamp and mount shown thin)
1. Symmetric top to bottom: turn it over for the other side. Front and rear share the lamp; only the ear moves if their screws differ.
2. Line inside faces with self-adhesive EPDM foam: plates 1 mm, back wall 2 mm, tip wall 3 mm, tabs 1 mm.
3. Slide on from the lamp tip, seat the ear on the boss, fit screw with Ø12-15 washer. Do not overtighten in plastic.
4. Nothing may sit in front of the lens face. Tabs only lap the chamfer above and below the light window.
5. Break all edges; outside corners R3 as drawn.
